message:
I remember the day my daughter called in a bit of a panic because her car broke down in the middle of nowhere. As I rushed to help her, I felt a wave of pride knowing that I had just put together a little go-bag for moments like these. It had water, snacks, and even a flashlight tucked in there, just waiting for its moment to shine. 

When I arrived, I handed her a bottle of water and a granola bar, and it felt so good to be the one prepared for a change. It reminded me that little steps toward readiness can make a big difference when life throws us a curveball. Have you ever found yourself in a similar situation?
